conventions.harmonics: y(phi) = sum_k Re(c_k exp(2 pi i k phi)), phi = stride phase from FL touchdown
conventions.lines: value = a + b x, x = Froude speed s (timing, apex, trunk) or stance travel / h (x_td, x_lo)

selection.note: forward speed |c_xy| in m/s at h0_robot; first matching row; lateral/backward = walk, extrapolated
